title: Several people share one channel, with one bot or more
description: Add and remove human participants on a channel, and allow a named channel with one bot. A person's message that names no bot lands in the bot's mailbox without starting a turn, so people can talk among themselves and the bot still sees it. Removing someone stops their reads and posts. Done: Gherkin scenarios for add, remove, unaddressed message, and refused access; routes declared in http/app.ts.
